source.license: Free brief extract; full paid/contractual; API ID-Austria-gated

access.note: Free brief extract (per company, viewing). JustizOnline API requires ID Austria. Full data/documents PAID via a Verrechnungsstelle contract. No open bulk.

pagination.note: Per-company lookup by Firmenbuchnummer/name. No population enumeration / open bulk. Exact API shape depends on the chosen clearing house or the ID-gated JustizOnline API.

parsing.notes: firmenbuchnummer keeps the check letter. UID = ATU + 8 digits. Geschäftszweig is free text (no ÖNACE). Organe are PII. AT number locale (comma decimal).

mapping_rules.activity: Geschäftszweig free text (derive) — no ÖNACE in public extract.

fixture_requirements: record with free-text Geschäftszweig only (no activity code)

live_test_plan.smoke: Not applicable without a clearing-house contract or ID Austria — do not attempt unauthenticated bulk.
live_test_plan.full: Behind a Verrechnungsstelle contract (or ID-Austria API), look up target companies by Firmenbuchnummer; persist raw; normalize. For scale prefer a commercial aggregator.

blockers: Full data is paid (clearing houses); free brief extract limited; API needs ID Austria.
